newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLICE SEEK LOST RUSSIAN BOXING KANGAROOS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLICE SEEK LOST RUSSIAN BOXING KANGAROOS.

text.p: Police in the central Poland town of Nowy Dwor advised residents on Tuesday to avoid contact with two kangaroos missing from a circus, saying both were skilled boxers and could turn violent.
"The animals can be dangerous because they are not friendly to people and have been taught to box," PAP news agency quoted a police duty officer as saying.
"Anyone meeting them should not try to come close," he added.
The Russian-trained kangaroos either fled or were stolen from a travelling circus, which had stopped in Nowy Dwor.
Police and circus staff were scouring the countryside for the two 1.4-metre male kangaroos, called Gin and Tonic, who belong to the Russian state circus and were brought by their trainers to Poland.
